claims.claim: On 14 August Spain’s government decreed a three-year extension for the Almaraz nuclear plants with combined capacity of about 2 GW.
claims.source_title: Spain Slows Nuclear Phase-out Amidst Energy Turbulence
claims.supporting_quote: In a significant policy twist, on 14 August Spain’s government decreed a 3-year extension for a pair of nuclear power plants with combined capacity of about 2 GW.

claims.claim: Spain’s battery storage capacity grew from 28 MW at the time of the blackout to 193 MW by April 2026.
claims.supporting_quote: At the time of the blackout, Spain had only 28 MW in battery storage capacity, but that number almost sextupled to 193 MW by April 2026.

claims.claim: The Ministry for Ecological Transition announced EUR 750 million for 65 resilience measures including synchronous condensers and flexible AC transmission systems.
claims.supporting_quote: In July 2025 Spain’s Ministry for Ecological Transition and Demographic Challenge (MITECO) announced EUR 750 million (US $ 874 million) investment in 65 new resilience measures, including synchronous condensers, flexible AC transmission systems, substation improvements, and switching relays.
